Oration Award 2026 SCRAC (Society for Cancer Research and Communication)- March 14, 2026, during a scientific gathering organized by the society. As part of the honour, Dr. Chaudhari delivered an insightful oration titled “The Translational Odyssey,” where he highlighted the journey of translating scientific knowledge into clinical applications, with a focus on improving cancer diagnosis and therapeutic strategies.
